rationale.consistency: Follows codebase patterns perfectly, including standard flag usage and well-structured package layout.
rationale.edge_cases: Correctly handles dry-runs, empty roots, name collisions, and robust lock management.
rationale.scope: Implements all requested functionality (preview/apply, subcommands, locking) without scope creep.
rationale.readability: Clean, modular code with descriptive variable names and helpful comments where necessary.
rationale.robustness: Uses atomic locking (O_CREATE|O_EXCL), explicit error handling, and safe directory traversal.
rationale.maintainability: Modular design separates discovery, inventory management, and commands, making it easy to test and extend.
